# BTicino C300X Integration v1.3.1

This pre-release replaces the withdrawn `v1.3.0` pre-release. It focuses on
easier setup, clearer media diagnostics, ready-made automations and a better
C300X display dashboard experience.

It updates the packaged native C300X device agent to `1.3.0`.

## Highlights

- Refocuses setup on HACS install, integration setup, agent setup, Media
  Readiness and the bundled card.
- Adds guided **Media readiness** repairs for common media setup problems:
  agent reachability, media-user/routing setup, forwarding, firewall and
  callback URL checks.
- Adds bundled automation blueprints for doorbell notifications, Ring Call
  notifications, Companion App dashboard notifications, Ring Capture, local
  Wyoming transcription and strict phrase decisions.
- Installs missing bundled blueprints into Home Assistant's blueprint folder
  when the integration loads.
- Improves the C300X display dashboard with dynamic home page support,
  configured entity order, per-entity display names/secondary text, selectable
  Alarm page quick action and richer weather display.
- Improves Ring Call and on-demand RTSP startup/recovery.
- Fixes Alarm page quick actions, Wyoming blueprint audio handling, Media
  Readiness wording/state and the idle RTSP-bridge diagnostics false warning.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Hard-reload the browser or clear the Home Assistant app/WebView cache if a
  dashboard still shows old card behavior.
- If you use C300X display pages, update the native C300X device agent from
  Home Assistant so active display patches can be refreshed.
